episode_definition: maximal run of consecutive 60-second windows sharing the same (attack_type, entity_key); a gap larger than one window length starts a new episode; an episode is detected if at least one of its windows has score >= threshold

emitted_holdout_negatives.produced_by: scripts/emit_thursday_benign_windows.py, delegating to the already-hashed policy path of scripts/audit_thursday_windows.py

excluded_populations: all Thursday web_attack windows (123 windows, 6 episodes)

guarantees.determinism: random_state=0, no sampling, no randomised split

hyperparameters.source: modules/detection/src/experiments/p1_evaluation.py decisions D6 and D7, adopted unchanged

impossible_to_guarantee: entity-disjoint evaluation of the DoS and DDoS families: all six sit on the same two entity keys
separating 'detects a DoS' from 'recognises the 172.16.0.1 -> 192.168.10.50 pair'
new infrastructure: Thursday is the same topology and shares 3 of the 4 priority entity keys
narrow confidence intervals: 28 episodes across seven families, five with <= 4 episodes
any statistical conclusion for FTP-Patator: one episode
priority-family positives on an independent capture: Thursday contains no FTP/SSH/DoS/DDoS family

metrics.confidence_interval: Wilson 95 percent, chosen in advance for small denominators and proportions of 0 and 1
metrics.fpr_definition: false positives / benign_reference windows, denominator exactly 32813, reported with the absolute false-positive count
metrics.primary: episode recall at the frozen threshold
metrics.roc_and_pr_auc_policy: reported only on the pooled holdout population where both classes are present; never used to choose a threshold or a model; PR-AUC always accompanied by its base rate
secondary: window recall at the frozen threshold
Thursday FPR and absolute false-positive count
ROC-AUC and PR-AUC on the pooled holdout population
achieved validation FPR at gel time

monday_benign_partition.expected_magnitude_note: roughly 56000 train and 14000 validation of the 70578 Monday windows; exact counts recorded at execution, not required to fix the protocol

not_entity_disjoint_declaration.claimed_property: unseen attack family + independent capture/day for benign FPR
not_entity_disjoint_declaration.statement: The holdout is NOT entity-disjoint at the IP or entity_key level.

required_additional_artifact.gate: if the row count differs from 32813 the protocol halts
required_additional_artifact.produced_by: scripts/audit_thursday_windows.py, same already-hashed policy code path, no new labelling decision
required_additional_artifact.reason: the audit JSON is an aggregate report holding counts only; scoring requires the VOL5 feature vector of each of the 32813 windows

success_criterion.aggregate_reporting: category of each of the seven families, pooled episode recall over the 28 episodes with its Wilson interval, and the seven Thursday FPR values with absolute false-positive counts; no pass/fail threshold such as 'four of seven'; no success threshold may be introduced after the results are seen
success_criterion.episode_recall_vs_fpr_comparison: forbidden: episode recall and FPR measure different things on different populations; a direct comparison is not a sound statistical justification, least of all for families with 1 to 4 episodes
success_criterion.fpr_transfers: the Thursday-measured FPR is at most 2 percent, that is twice the 1 percent calibration target; the factor two is fixed before any measurement and is the only numeric criterion
success_criterion.operating_point_degrades: otherwise; the fold's recall figures must then be read against the inflated FPR and cannot support a transfer statement

transfer_categories.limited_or_inconclusive_evidence: episode recall is non-zero but its Wilson interval is too wide to distinguish outcomes, or the measured FPR exceeds the tolerance so the recall cannot be read cleanly
transfer_categories.no_evidence_of_transfer: episode recall point estimate is zero, or its Wilson interval is consistent with zero
transfer_categories.results_compatible_with_transfer: episode recall is substantial and its Wilson interval excludes zero, at an operating point whose measured FPR is within the pre-registered tolerance

threshold_rule.calibration_population: VALIDATION benign only (Monday fold 4), entity-disjoint from the fitting set
threshold_rule.measurement_population: Thursday benign_reference, 32813 windows, never used for calibration
threshold_rule.rule: smallest candidate score t drawn from the observed negative scores such that mean(validation_negative_scores >= t) <= target_fpr
threshold_rule.source: modules/detection/src/experiments/p1_evaluation.py::threshold_at_train_fpr, applied to validation negatives instead of training negatives

thursday_benign_definition.exclusion_declared_intervals: all declared attack intervals including the two unlabelled Infiltration rules, 17615 windows
